patch_resolves_note: The staged patch inserts memset(ps_slice_hdr, 0, sizeof(*ps_slice_hdr)) immediately after slot selection in ihevcd_parse_slice_header(), and the fixed instrumented build is expected to satisfy the cleared-slot obligation while running clean on the staged PoC.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code site where an earlier non-IDR slice on the crashing decode path materializes the short-term-reference state family later consumed from stale `slice_header_t` storage.

The vulnerable decoder reuses a previously populated `slice_header_t` slot here without clearing it first, so later slice-header paths can preserve stale short-term-reference members across slice decodes.

ASan crash site. The stale short-term-reference tuple has already advanced `u4_num_st_foll` to the fixed stack-array bound, so this store writes a 17th `WORD32` into the 16-element `ai4_poc_st_foll` buffer.
Intermediate runtime event slice_refresh_gate materialized from verified transition assertion A-REFRESH-TO-REFLIST.
Intermediate runtime event ref_tuple_select materialized from verified transition assertion A-REFRESH-TO-REFLIST.
Intermediate runtime event positive_loop_entry materialized from verified transition assertion A-REFLIST-TO-LOOP.

edges.description: The short_term_ref_pic_set_sps_flag value preserved in ps_slice_hdr after the dependent-slice refresh gate is the same selector consumed by ihevcd_ref_list when it chooses which short-term-reference tuple to load.
edges.evidence: The last vulnerable slice_refresh_gate event records short_term_ref_pic_set_sps_flag=0 and the immediately following ref_tuple_select event records the same selector value 0.

edges.description: The total short-term-reference count loaded from the selected tuple is carried unchanged into the positive-picture loop bound computation.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable ref_tuple_select event records total_short_refs=29 and the first subsequent positive_loop_entry records the same total_short_refs=29.

edges.description: The u4_num_st_foll cursor observed at the positive-picture loop entry is the same array index used by the overflowing ai4_poc_st_foll store.
edges.evidence: On the crashing vulnerable iteration, positive_loop_entry.write_index=16 and the immediately following st_foll_store event uses the same write_index=16.
